More than 1,000 customers worldwide with over $3 trillion of assets under management put their trust in ECI. At ECI, we believe success is driven by passion and purpose. Our passion for technology is only surpassed by our commitment to empowering our employees around the world . ECI is a leading managed services provider serving the alternative investment and financial services industry. We are seeking a Network Implementation Manager to lead the team responsible for deploying, configuring, and handing off enterprise network solutions across our global client base. This role requires someone who is technically sharp enough to command respect from senior engineers and commercially astute enough to manage delivery timelines, client expectations, and team performance simultaneously. The right candidate has deep network engineering roots and has deliberately grown into a people management role — they know the difference between being the best engineer on the team and building the best engineering team. This role is hybrid for candidates based in Dallas TX area. Build a culture of execution discipline — ticket hygiene, change management compliance, documentation quality, and rigorous project close-out. Identify skill gaps and build structured training and certification pathways aligned to ECI’s service portfolio. Manage performance formally and informally; address issues directly, constructively, and on record when required. Participate in hiring decisions for the implementation function, including technical assessments and structured panel interviews. Project Delivery & Program Management Own end-to-end delivery of network implementation projects spanning new client onboarding, infrastructure refreshes, office builds, and technology migrations. Define and enforce project intake, scoping, scheduling, and resource allocation standards across the team. Drive post-implementation reviews and root cause analysis; translate findings into repeatable process improvements for the team. Strong working knowledge of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), VLANs, QoS, and IPv4/IPv6 fundamentals. Proven ability to run multiple concurrent implementation projects with accountability for schedules, resources, and stakeholder communication. Solid understanding of security frameworks, compliance standards, and change management governance in regulated client environments. Preferred Active CCNP, CCIE, or PCNSE certification; equivalent demonstrated expertise considered. Experience with SD-WAN (Cisco Viptela, VeloCloud) and SASE / Zero Trust architecture in client deployments. Familiarity with automation tooling (Python, Ansible) to drive repeatability and reduce manual effort across the team. Experience with network monitoring platforms (SolarWinds, PRTG, Meraki Insights) and using telemetry data to drive delivery quality. Hedge fund, financial services, or similarly regulated client-facing environment experience is a strong plus. Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field — or equivalent professional experience. Leads with clarity. Engineers respect them because they know the stack — not just the title. Commands technical credibility. Holds the team and themselves to high execution standards without micromanaging. Drives accountability. Focused on delivery quality and reliability, not just activity volume. Solves for client outcomes. Understands the job is to build the best team — not to be the best individual engineer on it. Scales through people.
